scientific_classification: Not a physics failure, not Cx(WorkLimit), and not an age-certificate numerical mismatch. Scalar actual-node audit had passed before the source-file lookup failed.
cause: The original source input was incorrectly inferred from the generated age_study output directory. A fresh-run output directory is independent of the source unit inputs directory.
fix: Explicit --source-inputs PATH is passed into verify_source. Its default resolves against the verifier script unit root, never the generated output directory.
